authority: Static organizational policy for state, House, private, personal, polity, rebel and mercenary military organizations. Exact manpower, formations, represented people, casualties, operations, ownership, appointments, external-personnel allocations and support allocations remain in their native campaign owners.

officer_representation_policy.high_potential_evidence_rule: High potential is never inferred from holding a billet. It requires saved screening, cohort, progression, performance or other exact provenance before it can justify individual representation.
officer_representation_policy.materialization_rule: Materializing an internal officer reclassifies one already conserved body from the exact owning force or formation. Representation never adds manpower.
officer_representation_policy.scale_rule: A command billet is an organizational assignment, not an instruction to create a character. Generic officers remain aggregate until a saved relevance trigger applies, except where an explicit formation profile requires stronger representation.

persistent_formation.rule: formation.personnel is fighting establishment. Unit command and separately attached support sit above fighting strength only when exact conserved owner-force external_personnel_allocations prove those bodies.

mercenary_company.rule: Mercenary headcount is total company personnel. Command and support are carved from that already conserved total by default. They do not increase company headcount unless a separate exact external attachment owner proves additional bodies.

unit_command.rule: The persistent unit commander and formal unit deputy are command-establishment personnel above the fighting-strength number for normal formations. Exact named people or aggregate command bodies must be conserved from an owning or lawfully attached force and never arise from narration.

deputy_policy.profile_override_rule: Explicit formation profiles may prohibit internal deputies. Qin 2,000-fighter units and the Great Bow Guard use commander-only 1,000/500/100 subordinate echelons.
deputy_policy.succession_rule: When a commander becomes dead, captured or incapacitated, a healthy formal unit deputy may act immediately without creating a new body. Internal subcommands without deputies fall to the best already-existing lawful subordinate or later appointment; the system never mints a replacement officer.

formation_command_structure.external_support_rule: For normal persistent formations, support personnel are outside fighting establishment and must be allocated from conserved owner-force roles at the formation's actual location. They increase attached headcount but not fighting strength or persistent unit slots. Missing support remains a real staffing shortfall.
formation_command_structure.external_allocation_owner_rule: The source force stores external_personnel_allocations by formation and role. Its cohort ledger stores the same bodies as allocated_external_by_formation. Reserve counters are debited while attached and restored only on lawful release; deaths reduce the conserved force headcount instead of returning bodies to reserve.
formation_command_structure.internal_officer_rule: Every internal command node is an assignment held by a soldier already inside the formation's fighting establishment. Materializing that commander converts one anonymous formation body into a represented person; it does not increase formation personnel.
formation_command_structure.temporary_subdivision_rule: A persistent cohort or internal command may be divided temporarily for battlefield control without rewriting the conserved cohort ledger or creating another persistent formation.

mercenary_command_structure.rule: Mercenary command nodes use the same scale-aware hierarchy, but generic officers remain aggregate. Unit command and support come from the company's existing total headcount unless a separate lawful attachment is saved. Important, exceptional or provenance-backed high-potential officers may later be materialized without changing total company manpower.

mercenary_training.rule: A living mercenary company uses its quarterly causal review to conduct role-specific aggregate drill when not destroyed or dissolved. Training advances the exact manpower-capability owner referenced by each troop pool under Sword's ordinary diminishing-return training law; it never creates character records or free headcount. Contracted House Tang defense companies therefore continue professional drill while on standing defensive duty, while deployed companies receive less deliberate drill and rely more on field exposure.

unit_command.deputy_rule: A deputy primarily improves continuity and throughput. A deputy is not an unrestricted additive stat bonus and cannot duplicate the commander's scale effects.

support.rule: Only actually allocated signal, staff and logistics bodies contribute. Target staffing without conserved allocation grants no mechanical benefit.

command_casualty_exposure.rule: After a committed battle establishes fighting losses, aggregate attached personnel take deterministic bounded losses from that already-settled exposure. They are separate casualties and reduce their source force headcount exactly once; a later staffing review may replace them from real reserve bodies.

qin_border_detachment.label: Qin Border Detachment
qin_border_detachment.rule: Tang Wei commands the Qin detachment from the higher field-army layer. The 8,000 Qin fighters are organized as four persistent 2,000-fighter units. Each unit has one full-character commander and one person-lite deputy outside fighting strength. Inside each unit are commander-only 1,000, 500 and 100 echelons: two 1,000 commanders, four 500 commanders and twenty 100 commanders, all person-lite and all drawn from conserved fighting bodies. Internal subcommands receive no formal deputies. Support remains separately conserved outside fighting strength.

tang_wei_house_contingent.label: Tang Wei House Contingent
tang_wei_house_contingent.rule: The Great Bow Guard and Tang Champions are separate persistent units. The 100 Tang Champions remain their own unit and preserve their existing named commander/deputy from campaign truth; this static policy does not duplicate or overwrite those appointments. The Great Bow Guard receives its own separate generated commander and deputy when lawfully materialized.

formation_qin_border_line.label: QIN Border Unit I
formation_qin_border_line.hierarchy_rule: One 2,000-fighter persistent unit contains two 1,000 commands; each 1,000 contains two 500 commands; each 500 contains five 100 commands. All 26 subordinate commanders are person-lite assignments held by soldiers inside this conserved 2,000 fighting establishment. Internal subcommands have no deputy billets.

formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.label: Great Bow Guard

external_unit_command.generation_policy: Generate and conserve a distinct Great Bow Guard unit commander and deputy during lawful live materialization. Do not reuse Tang Champion command and do not auto-transfer Sword Manor officers.

formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.hierarchy_rule: The tactical command tree is three 1,000 commands, six 500 commands and thirty 100 commands, for 39 person-lite internal commanders. These are overlapping echelon assignments over the same conserved 3,000 fighters and do not add manpower or formation slots. Internal subcommands have no deputies.
formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.officer_source_rule: Internal Great Bow Guard commanders arise from the accepted conserved Great Bow Guard recruitment body. The formal unit commander/deputy are distinct from Tang Champion command and must be lawfully generated/materialized from conserved eligible bodies. Sword Manor personnel are not transferred automatically.
formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.temporary_100_rule: The thirty 100-man tactical commands are command assignments inside the 3,000-fighter formation. The fifteen 200-person recruitment cohorts remain conservation provenance and are not separate tactical command units.

formation_tang_champions_first.label: Tang Champions

external_unit_command.appointment_rule: Preserve the exact existing campaign commander and deputy refs; static organization policy does not overwrite named appointments.

formation_tang_champions_first.hierarchy_rule: The 100 Tang Champions are one persistent unit, not a Great Bow Guard subcommand. The zero-count sentinel suppresses generic subordinate command generation in the current projection runtime. Their named unit commander and deputy remain campaign-owned appointments.

operation_depth.rule: Major operations may coordinate several complementary persistent formations when exact available formations and authority permit. The operation layer never merges their manpower, casualties, officers, equipment or ownership.

great_bow_guard.rule: The 3,000-fighter Great Bow Guard remains one persistent formation. Its tactical command tree is 3 x 1,000, 6 x 500 and 30 x 100 commander-only echelons over the same fighters. The fifteen 200-person cohorts remain recruitment/manpower provenance, not tactical command units. Internal commanders are person-lite conserved fighting bodies. The distinct Great Bow Guard unit commander is a full character and its unit deputy is person-lite; both are separate from Tang Champion command and require lawful conserved materialization.
